commits.message:
Ongoing huge code refactoring.
Moved more code to separate classes, like directions and current location.

Start of huge refactoring.
Adding ngrx Store to the project to be able to access the route and traffic information from several classes instead of storing this all in the MainView. Most new classes are small which is a good indication that we are heading the right direction.

Removed unnecessary test on zero distance when calculating the next instruction to present.
Made the section of the details smaller and dependent on the distance to the locations of the instructions.
Removed some typo's from README.md
Getting the next instruction to follow used a distance in meters, but it was expected as kilometers.

Updated README.md
Removed an issue with the myLocation in the details map. There was no check against null when using it in the view.
Added names to the route and traffic information. This can make combining them more accurate (if we would use them).

When unloading the page, all timers are now unsubscribed from. These would stay doing their thing, causing memory leaks and performance issues in the long run.
Added a lot of comments to the code.
Did a bit of refactoring

Refactoring of the code.
Instructions now have a better way of finding the next instruction.
The detailed information is now shown as an area of 4x4 km. Scale and width of the line segments are no longer dependent of the length of the route.
Detailed instructions rotate at an angle depending on where the next instruction is due.
Refactoring: putting stuff into separate classes, because mainview.component.ts is too crowded.

GitHub Actions only checks out the last commit.

It has therefore no knowledge about any other commits. We fix this by calling "git fetch".
After that it should be OK to do a checkout.
